calculation.description: For each tradable instrument, reverse its lagged five-session return residual to the contemporaneous cross-asset mean, normalize by lagged 20-session residual volatility, and scale by lagged VIX relative to its trailing 252-session median. Smooth three sessions, then cross-sectionally rank and demean. All predictive inputs are lagged at least one session. Higher values indicate stronger expected 10-session forward return.

validation.regime_notes: Positive full-sample and recent 365/750-session efficacy; longer 1260-session ICIR is below the admission threshold, so regime dependence and correlation with existing reversal factors require monitoring.
